name: Seduction: A Night with Raven
source:
You’re the newest member on the Teen Titans roster and you’ve been getting along well with everyone there. Kind of. Raven seems to be surprisingly distant with you, especially lately. One day she tells you to come to her room at night. You arrive at her door as requested. What happens next is up to you.

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Raven/256779]GameJolt[/url]]
